description: Got a tx hash but not the chain? Searches base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, gnosis and celo in parallel and returns where it was mined: status (success/reverted/pending), block, UTC time, confirmations, from, to, native value, method selector, nonce, gas used, effective gas price, fee (incl. L1 fee when the receipt has one), log and ERC-20 transfer-log counts, explorer link. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per call, paid with x402 (MCP transport: an unpaid call returns the x402 PaymentRequired object; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over HTTP: GET /api/tx-find.
name: tx_find
title: Find a tx on any of 8 EVM chains
